en.home_positioning: AI systems are becoming more powerful. We believe the next generation should make its claims about privacy, security and behavior checkable. People should be able to see evidence for the trust an AI service asks of them.

en.hero_scene_title: Your data passing through the seven layers of an AI system, from the chip up
en.hero_scene_desc: A conceptual illustration: the seven layers of an AI system as an exploded stack of seven plates, from the accelerator up to policy. At the bottom, an AI accelerator board: a GPU die ringed by memory stacks, beside a CPU with a padlock. Above it, in order: an inference server inside a glass enclave, with an attestation report beside it; a neural network and a dataset; generated text and an image with a provenance tag; agents calling tools; benchmark bars and a gauge; and at the top a sealed agreement, standards documents and a pair of scales. An indigo line, the chain of evidence, rises from the GPU die through a ring on every plate toward the seal: solid where a layer's evidence is bound to the layer below, dashed where that binding is still emerging, broken where there is none. The bottom two plates, the layers where trusted execution environments (TEEs) give direct evidence, are tinted indigo. On the ground beside the board, outside the stack, you stand talking with the system: a person seen from behind in an amber coat, holding a phone whose screen shows the same indigo ring. A dotted path carries your prompts and data from the phone through one object on every plate, from the GPU die up to the standards documents, and brings an answer back down to the phone. The layers are positions in this site's own scheme, not security levels, and the T1 to T7 tags on stories refer to them.
en.hero_scene_desc_live: The person starts in gray and gains color with each layer you check. Once all seven are checked, and unless your device asks for reduced motion, small dots of your data travel the path, indigo on the two lowest plates, and each plate's front edge lights as they reach it.

en.layers_dek: Each layer names a kind of claim that someone outside the provider can check, from the chip at T1 up to the laws, standards and agreements at T7. Each row also says who can check it. Layers are positions, not security levels: a higher layer is not safer, and it builds on the layers below without containing them. Checking can continue upward only while each layer's evidence is bound to the layer below it. TEEs give direct evidence at T1 and T2 and reach the other layers only through the code they measure.

en.hub_meta_description: Learn what TEEs and remote attestation establish for AI workloads, and track platforms, services and attacks that affect those checks.
en.hub_dek: A trusted execution environment (TEE) is a processor mode designed to keep a running AI workload's memory from the host and its operator. Its hardware also signs a report on the software it loaded. This page explains what a checked report establishes. It also tracks the platforms, services and attacks that change what such a report can show.

en.home_lead: As AI handles our data and acts on our behalf, we should be able to check who can access that data and whether the AI stays within the permissions we give it. We report on progress toward making AI systems verifiable across all seven layers, from hardware to governance.

zh.hero_scene_title: 你的数据流经 AI 系统的七个层级，从芯片往上
zh.hero_scene_desc: 概念示意图：AI 系统的七个层级画成七块分层展开的平板，从加速器一直到政策。最底层是一块 AI 加速器板：GPU 芯片四周环绕着内存堆栈，旁边是一颗带挂锁的 CPU。往上依次是：玻璃隔离区中的推理服务器，旁边立着一份证明报告；一个神经网络和一组数据集；生成的文本和一张带来源标签的图片；正在调用工具的智能体；评测柱状图和一个仪表盘；最上层是一份盖了印章的协议、几份标准文件和一架天平。一条靛蓝色的线代表证据链，从 GPU 芯片升起，穿过每块平板上的一个圆环，通向印章：某一层的证据已与下一层绑定之处为实线，绑定正在出现之处为虚线，尚未绑定之处断开。最底下两块平板呈靛蓝色，可信执行环境（TEE）在这两层提供直接证据。加速器板旁边的地面上、在这摞平板之外，站着正在和这套系统对话的你：一个穿琥珀色外套、背对观者的人，手机屏幕上是同样的靛蓝色圆环。一条点线代表你的提示词和数据，从手机出发，依次经过每块平板上的一件物品，从 GPU 芯片一直到最上层的标准文件，再把回答带回手机。层级是本站自己的划分，表示位置，不是安全等级；报道标签 T1–T7 即指这些层级。
zh.hero_scene_desc_live: 人物起初是灰色的，你每查看一层，颜色就恢复一些。七层都查看后，除非你的设备设置了减少动态效果，代表你的数据的小圆点会沿点线移动，在最底下两块平板上呈靛蓝色，每到一层，那块平板的前缘就会亮起。

zh.hub_dek: 可信执行环境（TEE）是处理器的一种运行模式，设计目标是让宿主机及其运营方读取不到 AI 工作负载运行时的内存。硬件还会为它加载的软件签署一份报告。本页说明一份核验无误的报告能确立什么，并追踪各类平台、服务与攻击，因为它们会改变这样一份报告所能说明的内容。

zh.hub_services_dek: Apple、Meta、Google 和 Cohere 把部分 AI 请求发往这样的服务器：其芯片会签署一份记录，说明服务器加载了哪些软件。至于公司以外的人能就这些软件核查什么，各家公开的设计并不相同。

zh.home_kicker: 可验证 AI 的新闻、分析与指南
zh.home_lead: 当 AI 处理我们的数据、代表我们采取行动时，我们应当能够核查：谁能接触这些数据，AI 是否只在我们授权的范围内行动。我们报道让 AI 系统从硬件到治理、在全部七个层级都可验证的进展。
zh.chain_legend: 贯穿各层编号的竖线是证据链：实线表示与下一层的绑定已有部署，虚线表示正在出现，断开表示尚无做法。链在哪里断开，核查就止于哪里。
zh.pop_note: 层级表示位置，不是安全等级。
